title: [Triggered] api-gateway requests timing out: p95 above 5s and 502/504 rate above 5%
body:
p95 latency on api-gateway is 5.6s and the 502/504 rate is 15.8% over the last 5 minutes (thresholds 5s and 5%).

Error Codes Monitored:
* 460 - 🛑 Client Closed Connection Before Timeout
* 500 - 🔧 Internal Server Error
* 501 - 🚫 Not Implemented
* 502 - 🌐 Bad Gateway
* 503 - ⏳ Service Unavailable
* 504 - ⏰ Gateway Timeout
